title: Relative differential sheaf of an algebraic space over its scheme base
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ with its small etale structure sheaf and module category [def-trf-algebraic-space] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the represented base $h_S$ and structural map $p:X\to h_S$ [def-sfb-smooth-integral-group-space], without imposing any group structure on $X$. On the existing small affine ringed model [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model], let $p^{-1}\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal O_X$ be the canonical inverse-image structural map [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. Form its sheaf of differentials by sheafifying sectionwise Kahler differentials, with the sectionwise universal derivation [def-sfb-sheaf-differentials]. Define $\Omega^1_{X/S}$ on the original small etale site by the inverse of the fixed module-restriction equivalence. For each affine etale basis chart and each regular function $x$, its universal differential $\mathrm dx$ is the sectionwise universal differential followed by sheafification and the inverse counit of that equivalence.

source.place: Tag 04CT (definition-sheaf-differentials), Tag 04BN (definition-module-differentials); basis transport along the existing small affine model.
